about: The whole-world audit (scripts/art/world_audit.py, docs/vision/world-audit.md): every 32 px cell of the world against the standards; a cell is green when every check measured there passes, amber on a soft finding (judged by eye, or pending a decision), red when it fails the standard. Regenerate with python3 scripts/art/world_audit.py.

detail.rule: detail_bar by kind, cleanliness included (house rulings)

grid-edges.rule: structure boundaries in straight runs of 16 px or more (80 % a cell)

rim-on-grid.rule: straight runs of 24 px or more on multiples of 8 px

tier-step.rule: tiers change only at a stair or ramp (tier map)

north-face.rule: faces only on south edges (tier map)

side-band.rule: side bands 1 to 2 cells (5 px) wide (tier map)

straight-run.rule: no straight boundary over 96 px (paths 240) without an 8 px jog

ruler-edge.rule: no pixel-straight contrast edge over 96 px

seam.rule: no cut, tone or terrain seam where zones, areas, scenery cells or chunks meet

palette.rule: on the house palette (90 %); pending Matt, so amber

dither.rule: no checker dither on walkable ground

size.rule: size_check range for every placed sprite

ledger.rule: asset ledger KEEP for every placed asset

density.rule: interactables and story props per screen (check 1)

empty-path.rule: no 200 px of path without something to notice (check 2)

identical.rule: no more than 3 identical props in a row (check 9)
